title: Choose the visual world for Redline
question: The roll assigned The Clause Field Guide. Keep it, take the bold alternate (Lotería), play the familiar pick (Marked Galley), or re-roll. One honest full-card challenger this round — the other five declined and sit demoted with the one discipline the field guide kept from each.

options.label: The Clause Field Guide
options.lineage: hand-coloured natural-history specimen plates & field guides
options.thesis: Every dangerous clause is a plated specimen: named, numbered, ranked by how badly it can bite, its exact sentence quoted as the diagnostic field mark.
options.viewport: Left, the raw contract page. Right, one Critical specimen plated: its name, an oxblood danger band with the Walk-away, the exact quoted sentence as the field mark, and the counter-move. The action is a collector's tray: try it on your own contract, parsed in your browser.
options.risk: Natural-history plates slide to cream-and-timid if the saturated specimen-case colours aren't committed at page scale.

raised.raise: Commit the plate's material all the way: engraved plates and real plate-paper are the ground, never a neutral template with a paper texture stuck on.
Reserve one oxblood strictly for Critical and the Walk-away, and reveal the quoted source sentence on intent rather than as always-on clutter.
Encode severity as visible magnitude: the specimen's size and band weight, not only a text label.
Keep flag to quoted sentence to source line an unbroken, deep-linkable chain.
Every visual property of a plate carries a real fact; nothing on the plate is decoration.

options.label: The Marked Galley
options.thesis: Your contract set as a galley proof: the dangerous lines struck in red, each margin correction mark naming the risk it flags.
options.viewport: One galley column of the real contract, red proof marks in the margin keyed to lines, the worst line circled in red with a named flag beside it; the action sits top-right.
options.risk: The literal reading of the name 'Redline' and the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Lotería Tabla
options.thesis: Each clause is a named, numbered icon card; the caller names the danger before the legalese, the way the riddle comes before the name.
options.viewport: Your contract as a tabla grid of called clause-cards; the current card enlarged, a Critical clause named and numbered with its icon, the quoted sentence set as the riddle beneath.
options.risk: A game grammar risks trivialising a serious signing moment, and audience identification is uneven across the freelancer base.
options.case: Holds the clarity axis: one named, numbered card per clause demonstrates 'each flag named' at a glance, and flat saturated colour proves energy is not the enemy of trust.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The analysis as a broadcast index: numbered pages, an answer hidden behind REVEAL.
options.case: Block-mosaic broadcast grid fights the trust mode, and freelancers aren't nostalgic for Ceefax.
options.kept: One alert-red reserved strictly for danger, and the evidence hidden behind a deliberate REVEAL.

options.label: Suminagashi Ink Basin
options.lineage: a shallow basin of marbled sumi ink
options.thesis: A liquid page where a fingertip drags marbled currents that obey real fluid law.
options.case: A fluid ink basin can't name, rank, or cite a sentence, and freelancers don't identify with sumi-nagashi.
options.kept: Total medium commitment: one material is the whole surface, obeying real law instead of decorating.

options.label: Fracture-Glaze Shelf
options.lineage: a kiln shelf of heavily glazed cups
options.thesis: Samples ranked in a shelf row by how far the molten glaze ran before it froze.
options.case: The molten-glaze metaphor muddies 'quote the exact sentence', and a kiln shelf isn't the freelancer's world.
options.kept: Severity read as physical magnitude: how far the glaze ran is how bad it is.

options.label: Orizuru Crane Folds
options.lineage: a vermilion square folded into a crane
options.thesis: One uncut sheet passing through thirty-two folds, every earlier crease still carried.
options.case: A fold sequence is a stepwise ritual, not the scan-the-ranked-dangers the task actually needs.
options.kept: Unbroken provenance: one sheet carries every earlier crease, any step deep-linkable.

options.label: Labanotation
options.thesis: A center staff read upward where shape is direction, shading is level, length is exact duration.
options.case: Reading a contract as a dance score is opaque; its legibility depends on training freelancers don't have.
options.kept: Every visual property carries exact meaning: shading is level, length is duration, nothing decorative.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The AI contract-review landing, executed impeccably: clean grid, a calm blue, a product screenshot.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero: headline and a single CTA on the left, a floating app screenshot on the right, a logo-strip beneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other contract-AI tool, by design.
